text: Hai Phong allocates land and sea area for four new berths at Lach Huyen port

The northern Hai Phong port city's People's Committee has approved the lease of 103.65 hectares of land and sea area to Lach Huyen Port Investment JSC for the construction of four new berths, numbered 9 to 12, at Lach Huyen port area in Cat Hai Special Zone.
The project received in-principle approval from the Prime Minister on July 8, 2025.
On July 14, 2025, the Hai Phong Economic Zone Authority approved Lach Huyen Port Investment JSC as the project investor.
The land and sea area lease will remain valid until July 8, 2095.
Earlier, on October 27, 2026, the municipal authorities approved a lease of 52.54 hectares of land and sea area to Saigon Newport Corporation for the construction of berths 7 and 8.
With these developments, Lach Huyen port area now comprises 12 berths.
Berths 1-6 are operational, while berths 7-12 are undergoing relevant land, sea-area and investment procedures.
Under the Prime Minister's Decision dated January 16, 2025, Lach Huyen is planned to accommodate 13-16 berths, with a long-term vision of expanding to 20 container berths by 2050.
